sections.title: Product Identity
sections.purpose: Resolved product name + canonical URL + one-line summary + resolution metadata so downstream readers know what was analyzed.

sections.title: Jobs to be Done
sections.purpose: 3-5 JTBDs the competitor's product serves, each one bullet + one-line rationale. Operator's clone must serve these too (or pick which to abandon).

sections.title: Feature List
sections.purpose: Table: Name | Description | Build-Complexity (S/M/L/XL) | Core-ness (1-5) | Evidence. Operator decides MVP slice vs. aspirational from these rows.

sections.title: Voice of Customer
sections.purpose: Table: Quote | Sentiment | Source | Retrieved. Every quote attributed to a cached source — fabricated quotes are stripped pre-emit.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.purpose: 3-7 named gaps with severity (low/med/high) where the competitor is weak and a clone has openings.

sections.title: Opportunities
sections.purpose: 3-5 capitalize-able hooks, each citing at least one gap or feature row — concrete bridges into /product:bootstrap or /sprint:plan.

sections.title: Source Attribution Log
sections.purpose: Append-only record of every URL fetched (with status + bytes + retrieved_at) plus every failure. Operator clicks through to audit any claim.
